name: Install two private homes and reinstall safely
detail: Both homes share the same code and native instruction/skill links; no private directories in code; reinstall preserves all private bytes and timestamps.

name: Refuse collisions and overlapping code/home paths
detail: Existing instructions, checkout, symlinked private directory, equal roots and both nesting directions were refused without overwriting private files.

name: Launch from a home or select a home explicitly
detail: Actual child process sees selected cwd and FM_HOME, shared FM_ROOT_OVERRIDE, exact argv and exit status; invalid home refuses before executing child.

name: Use the same queue command in two homes
detail: Identically named items are stored independently in each private backlog; shared code has no data directory.

name: Update shared code without changing either private home
detail: A real Git fast-forward makes the new executable visible in both homes; all private content, file modes and timestamps remain identical.

name: Preserve local code edits and branches during update
detail: Shared update refuses dirty code and a non-default branch rather than overwriting or switching them.
